title: MM6 Robot
description: MM6 hovering spherical robot: dark weathered gray steel upper and lower hemispheres with subtle etched swirling ornament, broad reflective silver/black middle shell panels with native pointed boundaries, narrow burgundy-red equatorial belt and small horizontal glowing yellow-white diamond eye at the front. Short stalk supports the small rectangular gray metal fitting on top. Preserve the native sphere shape, cap-panel boundaries, eye direction and attachment rotation. No limbs or added machinery.
regions: Gray shell and top fitting, red belt, and yellow eye are three independent palette materials; preserve their positions and native dark metallic shading.
